gates.requirement: Frozen hashes, snapshot, registered baseline, case identity, path identity, capacity, privacy, and output absence all pass.
Corrected reverses every active credited and same-contribution sibling mutation, while control remains audit-only.
Rolled back reverses the same persisted contribution unit after restart without touching another contribution.
Superseded hides the stored edge from normal activation without deletion and confirmed on the saved path reactivates it.
No reversed credited edge falls below its registered baseline.
Replay, restart, and injected transaction failure cannot duplicate or partially apply deactivation.
Only attributed credited and same-source sibling mutations change; lexical and unattributed controls do not mutate.
Source and snapshot remain unchanged, public output is private-free, and the registered output is exclusively created.
